svg.title: Grano · Classic Natural Granola 250 g · carton artwork

g.text: OPEN UP TO A BRIGHTER DAY.
A little crunch can change your perspective. Oats, pecans, walnuts, coconut,
blanched almonds and pumpkin seeds meet honey, cinnamon and peanut
butter in one joyfully classic blend.
Store in a cool, dry place. Reseal
